name: Knight of Xoroth (Defiance) tank threat abilities generate the threat their tooltips promise
contract: Chainwhip 800081 (High Threat Physical damage, client Spell.dbc effect 63 value 200) now carries spell_threat pctMod 3 from rev_20261026_20_coa_tank_ability_threat.sql, with no SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT flag (confirmed by DBC read), so a landed hit must put at least 2.9x its damage in threat. Demolisher 807336 promises 'Casting Flesh Hook or Chainwhip now taunts the target for 2 seconds'; its PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL effects (807522 'Demolished', SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT; 808007 'Demolisher', MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN) confirm the taunt exists in the installed data. Shieldgore (already spell_threat pctMod-fixed, entry 806874) is already exhaustively verified by coa-tank-ability-threat.json ('Shieldgore: threat is at least 2.1x its damage'); not duplicated here. Call: Hellfire Imp 804883's 'threat generated by Hellfire Imps is transferred to you' is confirmed OK by AscensionXorothSummons.cpp:114 (me->GetThreatMgr().RegisterRedirectThreat(706571, owner, 100), a 100% redirect); reproducing autonomous imp combat threat in this harness was judged out of proportion to a code-confirmed fixed-percentage redirect, so it is reported as a static finding only, not retested here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
OK: Chainwhip's threat is at least 2.9x its damage (spell_threat pctMod 3, no NO_THREAT attribute)
OK: Demolisher's taunt debuff (Demolished, SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT) lands on the target Chainwhip struck
OK: Demolisher's self-buff (808007, MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, -5% Physical damage taken) lands on the knight, not the target
